content: This is absolutely one of the best manhwa I've read. The progression system is so satisfying!
The art style really grew on me after the first few chapters. Highly recommend.
Marin Kitagawa is the best character in any romance manga, no contest.
The way they develop the relationship feels genuine. Not just the usual tropes.
Shadow is such a hilarious protagonist. He's delusional but it actually works perfectly.
Rimuru is one of the most likeable isekai protagonists. The world-building is impressive.
Started reading this for the hype and stayed for the incredible character writing.
Frieren is a masterpiece. The way it handles grief and the passage of time is beautiful.
Every chapter leaves me wanting more. The pacing is perfect.
Denji's story is unlike anything else. Fujimoto is a genius.
The ending divided fans but I thought it was bold and fitting.
Saitama's existential crisis is more interesting than most action manga protagonists.
